bottleneck: CPU cost of default lossless PNG compression; native FFmpeg PNG encoder supports frame threading.
codec: All 80 inputs are HEVC, yuv420p, BT.709, 234 frames; data56.mp4 is absent.
method: Fixed data1..data8, first 50 frames each; benchmarks sequential, no simultaneous benchmark variants. Samples are cached reads. File fsync reported separately.
scope: No daemon restart, live workflow modification, source video writes, or public registry publication.
limitations: 8-camera equivalent sample, not an end-to-end 80-camera gateway timing.
Pure decode data measures HEVC, not H.264.
JPEG/WebP quality metrics cover five data1 frames, not a COLMAP/3DGS reconstruction A/B.
4x4 and 8x2 encoding configurations differ by <1%; no claim of a statistically unique optimum.
A separate repository pytest run briefly overlapped the tail of parameter exploration/format measurements, using around half of one logical CPU; actual pack timings started after it exited.
